description: This file implements functions for URL handling, including parsing URLs, encoding and decoding URL components, and generating URL string representations. It appears to be part of a larger project related to web communication, with specific functions to manage URL schemes, parsing URL components, encoding/decoding methods, and URL serialization.

classes.name: URL
classes.description: A class providing URL parsing, encoding, decoding, and string serialization functionalities within the Thunder namespace.

methods.description: Decodes a URL-encoded string back into its original form.

methods.description: Encodes binary data into a Base64 string.

methods.description: Decodes a Base64 string into binary data.

methods.name: void Parse(const TextFragment & urlStr)
